mesajlar.mesaj:
Hello to you all,

Just a quick informational letter to you all. First, a very big thank you for making Hastings a great town to live, work and play.

The town hall wishes to give back to you, Hastingers and has organised an archery tournament. The Autumn Avalanche will take place from 6 to 13 October. Prizes are 1000 pounds, 500 pounds and 200 pounds. Also, Jaimie has added some extra fun to the tournament, but to find that out, please visit Hastings Grand Hall.

In other news, our market is stable. Militia duty is a quick way to make 10 pounds before the bell tolls and helps keep our town safe.

There was a robbery recently between Arundel and Lewes, so please be safe out there and ask for an escort if you need one. Nigel, the head of the army, should be able to help you.

All the best,
Tahsa
